readme_summary: The .NET integration platform for Ethereum and EVM-compatible blockchains. From smart contract interaction to a complete in-process Ethereum node, blockchain indexer, explorer, account abstraction bundler, MUD framework, multi-platform wallets, Unity integration, and .NET Aspire orchestration — 130+ packages targeting netstandard 2.0 through .NET 10 and Unity. The main Nethereum solution and projects: **github.com/Nethereum/Nethereum** For a complete guide to all 130+ packages, see **COMPONENTS.md**. Try Nethereum directly in your browser — chain interaction, Ether transfers, ERC20/ERC721, ENS, SIWE, HD wallets, log processing, and more. Sources: SmartContractDefault, OZ-Erc721-Erc1155, Metamask.Blazor, SIWE
